knobs.name: cutFade
knobs.what: s: half-length of the dip to the ground at each scene cut (30, 58, 84 s); 0 = hard cut

knobs.name: labelHold
knobs.what: frames a pin must be pushed before gl-labels hides it (hysteresis)

knobs.name: labelLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: shortest pin leader

knobs.name: pinSize
knobs.what: sheet units: species and band pin text (secondary floor 14)

knobs.name: resultSize
knobs.what: sheet units: result pins and slab readouts (must-read floor 28)

knobs.name: cubeSize
knobs.what: world units: edge of the measured box the 150 flowers sit in

knobs.name: pointR
knobs.what: world units: flower disc radius

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: extra disc size by view depth (0 = perspective only)

knobs.name: fog
knobs.what: depth fog toward the ground on the far flowers (exec ceiling 0.3)

knobs.name: revealAt0
knobs.what: s: first flower appears (t = 0 stays the empty box)

knobs.name: revealAt1
knobs.what: s: all 150 flowers shown

knobs.name: hookYaw0
knobs.what: degrees: camera azimuth at 0 s (negative = from the left)

knobs.name: camSwing
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth the camera orbits during HOOK (0-12 s)

knobs.name: hookPitch
knobs.what: degrees: camera elevation during HOOK

knobs.name: hookDist
knobs.what: world units: camera distance during HOOK (larger = smaller box)

knobs.name: s1LookY
knobs.what: world y the cloud camera looks at (larger moves the box up the frame)

knobs.name: turnT0
knobs.what: s: camera starts turning to face the petal-length axis

knobs.name: turnT1
knobs.what: s: camera faces the petal-length axis

knobs.name: caseYaw
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth facing the petal-length axis (0 = square on)

knobs.name: casePitch
knobs.what: degrees: elevation facing the petal-length axis

knobs.name: caseDist
knobs.what: world units: camera distance in CASE

knobs.name: colorAt
knobs.what: s: species colours start to come up

knobs.name: colorDur
knobs.what: s: species colours fade-in length

knobs.name: pinsAt
knobs.what: s: species pins appear

knobs.name: tickAt
knobs.what: s: the 1.9 cm tick (setosa's longest petal) is labelled

knobs.name: bandAt
knobs.what: s: the shared petal band (versicolor and virginica) is drawn

knobs.name: bandAlpha
knobs.what: opacity of the shared band's fill

knobs.name: hfSize
knobs.what: world units: width of the loss slice (setup-time)

knobs.name: hscale
knobs.what: world units: height of loss 1.4 (the scale top; setup-time)

knobs.name: contours
knobs.what: contour intervals over loss 0 to 1.4 (0 = off)

knobs.name: contourRole
knobs.what: pack role of the contour lines

knobs.name: planT1
knobs.what: s: the top-down plan view starts to tilt

knobs.name: tiltT1
knobs.what: s: the tilt into 3D ends

knobs.name: camEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation after the tilt (89 = plan)

knobs.name: camAz1
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth after the tilt (negative: the section face shows)

knobs.name: camSwing2
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth travel while the bead runs (45-58 s)

knobs.name: camDist0
knobs.what: x slice width: camera distance in plan view

knobs.name: camDist1
knobs.what: x slice width: camera distance after the tilt

knobs.name: ballAt
knobs.what: s: the bead (the weights at step 0) appears with its START pin

knobs.name: runT0
knobs.what: s: the bead starts down the slope on the linear step clock

knobs.name: stepsPerSec
knobs.what: steps per second of the bead's linear step clock

knobs.name: cutStart
knobs.what: s: the section cut snaps to the bead's column and the profile inset opens

knobs.name: beadR
knobs.what: world units: bead radius

knobs.name: trailW
knobs.what: px: descent path stroke

knobs.name: dropLine
knobs.what: opacity of the line from the bead to the ground (0 = off)

knobs.name: ghost
knobs.what: opacity of the path where the ground hides it (x-ray)

knobs.name: footAt
knobs.what: s: the footnote on what the ground is appears

knobs.name: profX
knobs.what: sheet units: profile inset left edge

knobs.name: profY
knobs.what: sheet units: profile inset top edge

knobs.name: layerX
knobs.what: world units: distance between the three layers

knobs.name: stackH
knobs.what: world units: height of each layer's stack of slabs

knobs.name: slabGap
knobs.what: world units: gap between slabs of one layer

knobs.name: zSpread
knobs.what: world units: depth between neighbouring slabs of one layer (the cutaway)

knobs.name: curv
knobs.what: ribbon spline handle length

knobs.name: widthGain
knobs.what: world units of band width per unit of |weight|

knobs.name: thick
knobs.what: world units: band depth

knobs.name: ribbonMix
knobs.what: ribbon colour toward the muted role (lower = darker)

knobs.name: fogK
knobs.what: depth fog on ribbons and slabs (exec ceiling 0.35)

knobs.name: stripes
knobs.what: flow stripes on the ribbons (0 at exec)

knobs.name: grow
knobs.what: s: ribbons draw on from 58 s

knobs.name: travel
knobs.what: s: a flower rides one ribbon

knobs.name: depart
knobs.what: s: spread of the 150 departures in one ride

knobs.name: markSize
knobs.what: world units: side of one flower mark

knobs.name: wEase
knobs.what: s: ribbon widths ease to the next checkpoint before its ride

knobs.name: ride0
knobs.what: s: the step-0 ride starts (it lands before the count at 61 s)

knobs.name: ride10
knobs.what: s: the step-10 ride starts

knobs.name: ride50
knobs.what: s: the step-50 ride starts

knobs.name: ride100
knobs.what: s: the step-100 ride starts

knobs.name: ride1000
knobs.what: s: the step-1,000 ride starts

knobs.name: ratioDelay
knobs.what: s: the ratio line follows its count by this much

knobs.name: az3
knobs.what: degrees: network camera azimuth at 58 s

knobs.name: swing3
knobs.what: degrees: network camera azimuth travel over 58-84 s

knobs.name: el3
knobs.what: degrees: network camera elevation

knobs.name: dist3
knobs.what: world units: network camera distance

knobs.name: netX
knobs.what: world x the network camera looks at (larger moves the network left)

knobs.name: brushT0
knobs.what: s: the step clock starts (lit = right at step k)

knobs.name: brushT1
knobs.what: s: the step clock reaches step 1,000

knobs.name: brushClock
knobs.what: step clock of the brushed cloud

knobs.name: brushRamp
knobs.what: steps: a flower's fade when it turns right or wrong

knobs.name: dim
knobs.what: how far wrong flowers dim toward the ground

knobs.name: litGrow
knobs.what: extra size of a lit (right) flower

knobs.name: costYaw
knobs.what: degrees: cloud camera azimuth during the step clock

knobs.name: costSwing
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth travel during the step clock

knobs.name: costPitch
knobs.what: degrees: cloud camera elevation during the step clock

knobs.name: costDist
knobs.what: world units: cloud camera distance during the step clock

knobs.name: s1bLookX
knobs.what: world x the cloud camera looks at in COUNT (negative moves the box right, clear of the step chart)

knobs.name: dollyT0
knobs.what: s: the dolly to the overlap starts

knobs.name: dollyT1
knobs.what: s: the dolly ends

knobs.name: dolly
knobs.what: world units: camera distance at the end of the dolly

knobs.name: dollyYaw
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth at the end of the dolly

knobs.name: rowPinsAt
knobs.what: s: pins on rows 84 and 134

knobs.name: rulerW
knobs.what: sheet units: width of the log step chart

knobs.name: mondayAt
knobs.what: s: the cloud dims for MONDAY

knobs.name: mondayDim
knobs.what: how far the cloud dims in MONDAY (0.7 = 30 % left)
